primary_source_receipts.finding: McClure, Laibson, Loewenstein, Cohen, Science 306:503-7: limbic regions tied to the midbrain dopamine system are preferentially activated by immediately available rewards; lateral prefrontal and posterior parietal cortex are engaged uniformly across intertemporal choices; relatively greater fronto-parietal activity is associated with choosing longer-term options.
primary_source_receipts.limitations: Single fMRI study, abstract level; sample and replication not assessed; does not quantify relative system strength.

primary_source_receipts.finding: Ersner-Hershfield, Wimmer, Knutson, Soc Cogn Affect Neurosci 4:85-92: individual differences in rostral anterior cingulate activation for current versus future self predicted temporal discounting measured a week later.
primary_source_receipts.limitations: Abstract level; participants rated selves, they were not shown scans; does not establish universal future-self/stranger equivalence.

primary_source_receipts.finding: Hagger et al., Perspectives on Psychological Science 11:546-73: a 23-lab preregistered replication with 2,141 participants found ego depletion small, d = 0.04, with a 95% CI including zero.
primary_source_receipts.limitations: One paradigm (letter-crossing/MSIT); does not rule out every self-control fatigue account.
